description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for managing quizzes in an LMS backend, including listing, creating, retrieving, submitting, and viewing attempts for quizzes, with AI integration for quiz generation.

methods.name: isInstructor
methods.description: Checks if a user role corresponds to an instructor or admin roles.

methods.name: isLearner
methods.description: Checks if a user role is 'learner'.

methods.name: isValidId
methods.description: Validates if a raw input is a positive integer ID.

methods.name: isUserEnrolledInCourse
methods.description: Checks if a user is enrolled in a specific course.

methods.name: normalizeManualQuiz
methods.description: Normalizes and validates manual quiz questions ensuring correct format and constraints.

methods.name: questionsForTake
methods.description: Prepares quiz questions for the take endpoint by stripping correct answers.
